description:
# silence!

A simple, lightweight microphone mute toggle for Windows with global hotkey support.

## Features

- **Global Hotkey** â€” Mute/unmute your microphone from anywhere using a customizable keyboard shortcut
- **System Tray** â€” Lives quietly in your system tray with a color-coded icon (green unmuted / red muted)
- **Quick Toggle** â€” Single click on the tray icon to toggle mute state
- **Visual Overlay** â€” Optional always-on-top indicator showing your mute status with smooth animations
- **Sound Feedback** â€” Audio cues when you mute/unmute with 8 preloaded sounds or custom sounds
- **Modifier Support** â€” Use complex hotkeys like `Ctrl + Alt + M` or simple ones like `F13`
- **Flexible Matching** â€” Option to ignore additional modifiers
- **Auto-Start** â€” Optionally launch with Windows
- **Modern UI** â€” Mica/Acrylic backdrop, smooth animations, native Windows 10/11 look
- **Portable** â€” No MSIX installer required, just extract and run

## What's New in v1.4

### Complete Overlay Rewrite
- **Pure Win32 Layered Window** â€” Faster, lighter, and actually works properly
- **True Click-Through** â€” Overlay is completely invisible to your cursor
- **Smooth Animations** â€” Buttery smooth fade-in/fade-out animations

### Appearance Customization
- **Show Text Option** â€” Toggle between icon-only or icon with text
- **Icon Styles** â€” Choose between colored (red/green) or monochrome icons
- **Background Styles** â€” Dark or light background
- **Opacity Controls** â€” Separate sliders for background and content opacity
- **Border Radius** â€” Adjust corner rounding from 0px to 24px
- **Border Toggle** â€” Show or hide the Windows 11 style border

### New Visibility Mode
- **Show After Toggle** â€” Overlay appears briefly after you mute/unmute, then disappears automatically
- **Customizable Duration** â€” Set how long the overlay stays visible (0.1 to 10 seconds)

## System Requirements

- Windows 10 version 1809 (build 17763) or later
- Windows 11 supported
- .NET 8.0 Runtime (included in installer)
